# Bob's CLI: A local-first AI coding CLI that adapts to you

Bob's CLI is a local-first AI coding assistant that runs entirely on your own hardware with no API costs and no data leaving your machine. It lives in the terminal, remembers project architecture and user patterns through 'behavioral DNA profiling', and supports features like conversation forking, autonomous code review, and SovereignLink — a remote execution mode that lets you send commands from any device while code stays on your home machine. Aimed at developers with limited time (side-project builders, part-time coders), it requires no cloud subscription on the free tier.

## Usage

On the terminal start typing `bob` and afterwards specify what you want to do.
`cli-bob` will then generate a command proposal for you and you can hit ENTER to run it.
You can also modify the command before running it.
Hit ESC to cancel execution.
